response.overview: The Tree of Life is a poetic experimental short film that explores the relationship between memory, existence, and time. Narrated by a spectral voice drifting through the misty landscapes of a swamp, the film blends voice-over, rhythmic music, and cinematic imagery of nature to visualize inner emotions and transformation.  Through its reflective storytelling, the film blurs the boundaries between past, present, and future while contemplating human transience and our connection to the natural world.
response.title: Tree of Life
